title.zh: 卷246 列傳三十三 谭泰 何洛会 锡图库 博尔辉 冷僧机
title.en: Volume 246 Biographies 33: Tan Tai, He Luohui, Xi Tu Ku, Bo Er Hui, Leng Sengji
title.raw: 卷246 列傳三十三 谭泰 何洛会 锡图库 博尔辉 冷僧机

sentences.zh: 譚泰，舒穆祿氏，滿洲正黃旗人，揚古利從弟也。

translations.literal: Tan Tai, of the Šumuru clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a younger cousin of Yangguli.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai, of the Šumuru clan, belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner; he was Yangguli's younger cousin.

sentences.zh: 初授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: At first he was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was first made a company commander.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，擢巴牙喇章京，與固山額真圖爾格分統左右翼兵，略錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he was promoted to bayara janggin; with gusa ejen Turgut he jointly commanded the left and right wing forces and raided Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tiancong he rose to bayara banner colonel and, with banner commander Turgut, led the left and right wings in a raid on Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 還從太宗伐明，自上方堡毀邊牆以入，敗明兵，克保安州。

translations.literal: Returning, he followed the Taizong in attacking Ming; entering by destroying the border wall at Shangfangbao, he defeated Ming troops and captured Bao'an prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he joined Taizong's campaign against Ming, broke through the frontier wall at Shangfangbao, routed the Ming army, and took Bao'an.

sentences.zh: 擢巴牙喇纛章京，令關白諸事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to bayara banner standard-bearer and ordered to report on all affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to chief of the bayara guard and charged with bringing matters before the throne.

sentences.zh: 九年，揚古利賜第，侍衛宗室濟馬護欲得其舊居，揚古利不可。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, when Yangguli was granted a residence, the imperial guardsman Jimalu of the imperial clan wished to obtain his old dwelling; Yangguli refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Yangguli received a grand residence; the guardsman Jimalu, a member of the imperial clan, wanted his old house, but Yangguli would not yield it.

sentences.zh: 濟馬護囑譚泰入奏，譚泰匿不以聞，濟馬護訴於上，上責譚泰曰：「爾為朕耳目，凡事當無隱。

translations.literal: Jimalu had Tan Tai enter with a memorial; Tan Tai concealed it and did not report it. Jimalu complained to the sovereign, who reproached Tan Tai, saying: "You are my eyes and ears; in all matters there should be nothing concealed.
translations.idiomatic: Jimalu asked Tan Tai to present the matter in memorial; Tan Tai kept it back and did not report it. When Jimalu appealed to the throne, the emperor rebuked Tan Tai: "You are my eyes and ears—nothing should be hidden from me.

sentences.zh: 濟馬護乃朕叔父之子，其言尚不能達，民間勞苦嗟怨，何由得使朕知？

translations.literal: Jimalu is my uncle's son—if even his words cannot reach me, how can the people's toil, sighs, and complaints ever come to my knowledge?
translations.idiomatic: Jimalu is my uncle's son; if even he cannot be heard, how will I ever learn of the people's labor and grief?

sentences.zh: 爾恃宗族強盛，欺陵愚弱，朕所深惡！」

translations.literal: You rely on your clan's strength to bully the simple and weak—this is what I deeply abhor!"
translations.idiomatic: You lean on your powerful kin to oppress the weak—that I loathe above all!"

sentences.zh: 下刑部質訊，奪官。

translations.literal: He was handed to the Board of Punishments for interrogation and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: The case went to the Board of Punishments; he lost his post.

sentences.zh: 尋复授本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: Soon he was again appointed gusa ejen of his own banner.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was restored as banner commander of his regiment.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格等伐明，克延慶等十二城。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Wuying Ajige and others in attacking Ming and captured twelve cities including Yanqing.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he marched with Prince Wuying Ajige against Ming and took a dozen cities, among them Yanqing.

sentences.zh: 進圍定興，先登有功。

translations.literal: Advancing to besiege Dingxing, he was first to scale the wall and distinguished himself.
translations.idiomatic: At the siege of Dingxing he led the assault over the wall and won merit.

sentences.zh: 復與固山額真阿山等設伏，敗明遵化三屯營守兵，盡殲之。

translations.literal: Again, with gusa ejen Ashan and others he laid an ambush, defeated the Ming garrison of the Santunying camp at Zunhua, and annihilated them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: With banner commander Ashan he ambushed the Santunying garrison at Zunhua and wiped it out.

sentences.zh: 師還，宴勞。

translations.literal: When the army returned, a feast was held in his honor.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was feasted for his service.

sentences.zh: 復從上伐朝鮮，朝鮮王棄城走，譚泰率師入其城，盡收其輜重。

translations.literal: Again he followed the sovereign in attacking Korea; the Korean king abandoned the city and fled. Tan Tai led troops into the city and seized all its baggage train.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the sovereign's Korean campaign; when the king fled, Tan Tai entered the capital and seized the entire baggage train.

sentences.zh: 從上逐朝鮮王至南漢城，受降而還。

translations.literal: Following the sovereign in pursuing the Korean king to Namhansong, he accepted surrender and returned.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued the king to Namhansong, took his surrender, and marched home.

sentences.zh: 四年，從睿親王多爾袞等伐明，與固山額真葉臣自太平寨破青山口，與明兵十三戰，皆捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Prince Rui Dorgon and others in attacking Ming; with gusa ejen Yechen he broke through Qingshankou from Taipingzhai and fought thirteen engagements with Ming troops, all victorious.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he followed Prince Rui Dorgon against Ming; with Yechen he broke Qingshankou from Taipingzhai and won thirteen battles in a row.

sentences.zh: 輔國將軍鞏阿岱，濟馬護兄也，譚泰與相詬於禁門，坐罰。

translations.literal: Auxiliary State General Gongadai, Jimalu's elder brother, exchanged insults with Tan Tai at the forbidden gate; Tan Tai was punished for it.
translations.idiomatic: Gongadai, Jimalu's elder brother and an auxiliary state general, traded insults with Tan Tai at the palace gate; Tan Tai was fined.

sentences.zh: 六年，從圍錦州，譚泰將四百人自小凌河直抵海濱，絕明兵歸路。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, during the siege of Jinzhou, Tan Tai led four hundred men from the Xiaoling River straight to the seashore, cutting off the Ming army's line of retreat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, at Jinzhou, he took four hundred men down the Xiaoling to the coast and severed the Ming line of retreat.

sentences.zh: 與明總督洪承疇兵戰，大敗之。

translations.literal: He fought the troops of Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou and routed them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: He met Ming governor-general Hong Chengchou in battle and crushed his army.

sentences.zh: 授世職二等參將。

translations.literal: He was granted a hereditary office as second-rank deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: He received a hereditary second-rank deputy commander's post.

sentences.zh: 七年，從輔國公篇古等攻薊州，擊敗明總兵白騰蛟、白廣恩等，俘馘為諸軍最。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Auxiliary State Duke Pangu and others in attacking Jizhou, defeated Ming regional commanders Bai Tengjiao, Bai Guang'en, and others, and took the most captives and heads among all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he joined Auxiliary State Duke Pangu against Jizhou, routed Bai Tengjiao and Bai Guang'en, and led all forces in prisoners and heads taken.

sentences.zh: 八年，命率銳卒與固山額真準塔更番戍錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was ordered to lead picked troops with gusa ejen Zhunta to rotate in garrison at Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he and banner commander Zhunta took elite detachments in rotating garrison at Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，逐破李自成於慶都。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed in entering the Pass and pursued, defeating Li Zicheng at Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he crossed into China and drove Li Zicheng from Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 復將巴牙喇兵躡擊，至真定，大破之，敘功授一等公。

translations.literal: Again commanding bayara troops in pursuit, he reached Zhending and inflicted a great defeat; for his merit he was granted the rank of first-class duke.
translations.idiomatic: Leading the bayara guard in pursuit to Zhending, he shattered Li's forces and was raised to first-class duke for his service.

sentences.zh: 睿親王攝政，譚泰與巴牙喇纛章京圖賴、啟心郎索尼並見信任。

translations.literal: When Prince Rui acted as regent, Tan Tai, together with bayara standard-bearer Tulai and investigatory secretary Sonin, all received his trust.
translations.idiomatic: Under Prince Rui's regency Tan Tai, together with Tulai, chief of the bayara guard, and Sonin the investigatory secretary, all enjoyed the prince's trust.

sentences.zh: 固山額真何洛會誣肅親王豪格怨譚泰等不附己，訐之睿親王，王謂譚泰忠，益信任之。

translations.literal: Gusa ejen He Luohui slandered Prince Su Hooge as resenting Tan Tai and others for not siding with him, and reported this to Prince Rui; the prince said Tan Tai was loyal and trusted him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Banner commander He Luohui alleged that Prince Su Hooge resented Tan Tai's refusal to follow him and reported it to Prince Rui, who called Tan Tai loyal and relied on him still more.

sentences.zh: 大學士希福忤譚泰，希福欲易賜第，譚泰不可，希福誚之，益怒。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Hifu offended Tan Tai; Hifu wished to exchange his granted residence, Tan Tai refused, Hifu mocked him, and Tan Tai grew still angrier.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Hifu crossed Tan Tai; when Hifu sought to swap his granted mansion and Tan Tai refused, Hifu taunted him and Tan Tai's wrath only deepened.

sentences.zh: 其弟譚布以希福述睿親王自言過誤告譚泰，譚泰訐之法司，希福坐黜。

translations.literal: His younger brother Tan Bu reported to Tan Tai that Hifu had recounted Prince Rui's self-confessed errors; Tan Tai denounced this to the judicial offices, and Hifu was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Tan Bu told him that Hifu had repeated Prince Rui's own admission of faults; Tan Tai reported it to the courts and Hifu was removed.

sentences.zh: 二年，英親王阿濟格坐奏軍事不實得罪，命譚泰與鰲拜等集眾宣其罪。

translations.literal: In the second year Prince Ying Ajige was punished for reporting military affairs untruthfully; Tan Tai and Oboi and others were ordered to assemble the multitude and proclaim his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Prince Ying Ajige was condemned for false military reports; Tan Tai and Oboi were told to gather the court and announce his guilt.

sentences.zh: 譚泰匿諭旨不以示眾，索尼發其罪，降世職昂邦章京，奪官。

translations.literal: Tan Tai concealed the edict and did not show it to the assembly; Sonin exposed his crime; he was reduced to hereditary rank as Angbang janggin and stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai withheld the edict from the assembly; when Sonin exposed him he was reduced to angbang banner colonel and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 譚泰怨索尼，訐索尼於內庫牧馬鼓琴及禁門橋下捕魚，索尼亦坐黜。

translations.literal: Tan Tai resented Sonin and denounced him for pasturing horses and playing the zither in the inner treasury and fishing under the forbidden-gate bridge; Sonin too was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai turned on Sonin, accusing him of grazing horses and playing music in the inner storehouse and fishing under the palace bridge; Sonin was removed as well.

sentences.zh: 譚泰復起為本旗固山額真。

translations.literal: Tan Tai was restored as gusa ejen of his own banner.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai was soon back as banner commander of his regiment.

sentences.zh: 初，師下江南，譚泰自西安逐捕流寇，慮不與平江南功，使謂圖賴曰：「我軍道迂險，後至。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the army marched south of the Yangtze, Tan Tai was pursuing bandits from Xi'an and feared he would miss credit for pacifying the south; he had someone tell Tulai: "Our route was long and perilous—we arrived late.
translations.idiomatic: When the army went south, Tan Tai was chasing rebels from Xi'an and feared missing the Jiangnan campaign; he sent word to Tulai: "Our march was long and hard—we came late.

sentences.zh: 今南京未下，請留待我軍。」

translations.literal: Nanjing is not yet taken—please wait for our army."
translations.idiomatic: Nanjing is still untaken—please hold until we arrive."

sentences.zh: 圖賴書告索尼，使啟睿親王，或發觀之，懼譚泰得罪，毀其書勿使達索尼。

translations.literal: Tulai wrote to inform Sonin and have him report to Prince Rui; someone who saw it, fearing Tan Tai would be punished, destroyed the letter so it never reached Sonin.
translations.idiomatic: Tulai wrote Sonin to raise it with Prince Rui; someone who saw the letter, fearing for Tan Tai, destroyed it before it reached Sonin.

sentences.zh: 圖賴師還，詰索尼，發其事，王鞫齎書者，得狀。

translations.literal: When Tulai's army returned he questioned Sonin; the affair came to light; the prince interrogated the letter-bearer and obtained the facts.
translations.idiomatic: On Tulai's return he pressed Sonin; the matter surfaced; Prince Rui examined the messenger and learned the truth.

sentences.zh: 譚泰又坐與婦翁固山額真阿山遣巫者治病。

translations.literal: Tan Tai was also implicated because his father-in-law, gusa ejen Ashan, had sent a shaman to treat illness.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai was further charged because his father-in-law, banner commander Ashan, had employed a shaman for healing.

sentences.zh: 下廷臣議罪，論死，下獄，王使視之，並餽食焉。

translations.literal: The court ministers were ordered to deliberate his crime; death was proposed and he was imprisoned; the prince sent someone to see him and even sent him food.
translations.idiomatic: The court debated his guilt and sentenced him to death; in prison the prince sent attendants—and food as well.

sentences.zh: 譚泰曰：「王若拯我，我殺身報王！」

translations.literal: Tan Tai said: "If Your Highness saves me, I will give my life in return!"
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai said, "If you spare me, I will repay you with my life!"

sentences.zh: 乃出之獄。

translations.literal: He was then released from prison.
translations.idiomatic: He was released from prison.

sentences.zh: 五年，復原官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year his former office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was restored to office.

sentences.zh: 金聲桓叛江西，授譚泰征南大將軍，率師討之。

translations.literal: When Jin Shenghuan rebelled in Jiangxi, Tan Tai was appointed Grand General for the Southern Campaign and led an army to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: When Jin Shenghuan rose in Jiangxi, Tan Tai was made grand general of the southern expedition and marched against him.

sentences.zh: 聲桓以步騎七萬人抗我師，譚泰督諸軍與戰，次九江，大敗聲桓兵，獲其舟以濟師。

translations.literal: Shenghuan opposed our army with seventy thousand infantry and cavalry; Tan Tai directed the forces in battle; at Jiujiang he routed Shenghuan's troops and seized his boats to ferry the army.
translations.idiomatic: Shenghuan met him with seventy thousand foot and horse; at Jiujiang Tan Tai crushed his army and took his boats to cross the river.

sentences.zh: 攻南昌，為長圍困之，數月，麾將士以雲梯登，聲桓中二矢，投水死；

translations.literal: He attacked Nanchang and invested it in a long siege; after several months he ordered the troops to scale with cloud-ladders; Shenghuan was struck by two arrows and drowned himself;
translations.idiomatic: He besieged Nanchang for months, then ordered an assault by scaling ladders; Shenghuan took two arrows and threw himself into the water;

sentences.zh: 又破其將王得仁。

translations.literal: he also defeated his general Wang Deren.
translations.idiomatic: he also broke Shenghuan's general Wang Deren.

sentences.zh: 南康、瑞州、臨江、袁州並下。

translations.literal: Nankang, Ruizhou, Linjiang, and Yuanzhou all fell together.
translations.idiomatic: Nankang, Ruizhou, Linjiang, and Yuanzhou fell in turn.

sentences.zh: 當聲桓叛時，李成棟以廣東應之，南昌圍急，成棟赴援。

translations.literal: When Shenghuan rebelled, Li Chengdong responded from Guangdong; as the siege of Nanchang grew urgent, Chengdong came to relieve it.
translations.idiomatic: When Shenghuan rebelled, Li Chengdong rose in Guangdong; as Nanchang tightened, Chengdong marched to its aid.

sentences.zh: 譚泰師將至贛州，聞成棟入信豐，譚泰遣諸將乘勝襲擊，成棟兵潰，溺水死，克信豐。

translations.literal: Tan Tai's army was approaching Ganzhou when he heard Chengdong had entered Xinfeng; Tan Tai sent generals to strike while victory was hot; Chengdong's troops collapsed, he drowned, and Xinfeng was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Near Ganzhou Tan Tai learned Chengdong was at Xinfeng; he sent generals in pursuit, Chengdong's force broke, he drowned, and Xinfeng was taken.

sentences.zh: 別將徇撫州、建昌。

translations.literal: Separate columns swept Fuzhou and Jianchang.
translations.idiomatic: Other columns overran Fuzhou and Jianchang.

sentences.zh: 江西悉平。

translations.literal: Jiangxi was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 師還，授一等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted first-class jingqi nihaan.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was given a first-class jingqi nihaan hereditary rank.

sentences.zh: 七年，睿親王薨，上命吏、刑、工三部增設滿洲尚書各一，授譚泰吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Prince Rui died; the sovereign ordered that each of the Boards of Personnel, Punishments, and Works add one Manchu minister, and Tan Tai was appointed Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, after Prince Rui's death, the throne added a Manchu minister to each of the Personnel, Punishments, and Works boards; Tan Tai became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 八年，世祖親政，追論睿親王罪狀，大學士剛林、祁充格皆坐誅，罪不及譚泰。

translations.literal: In the eighth year the Shizu assumed personal rule and reviewed Prince Rui's crimes; Grand Secretaries Gang Lin and Qi Chongge were both executed, but the guilt did not reach Tan Tai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year the Shizu took power and prosecuted Prince Rui's crimes; Gang Lin and Qi Chongge were executed, but Tan Tai was not implicated.

sentences.zh: 時圖賴已卒，索尼方罪廢，譚泰毀圖賴墓室，洩舊忿。

translations.literal: Tulai was already dead and Sonin had just been punished and dismissed; Tan Tai destroyed Tulai's tomb chamber, venting an old grudge.
translations.idiomatic: Tulai was dead and Sonin had just been disgraced; Tan Tai wrecked Tulai's tomb, settling an old score.

sentences.zh: 五月，御史張煊劾大學士陳名夏等，下王大臣會鞫。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Censor Zhang Xuan impeached Grand Secretary Chen Mingxia and others; the case was sent to the princes and ministers for joint trial.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Censor Zhang Xuan impeached Chen Mingxia and other grand secretaries; princes and ministers were convened to try the case.

sentences.zh: 譚泰袒名夏，讞上，命未下，譚泰前奏，言煊劾皆虛，且所舉諸事皆在赦前，煊以外轉嫌，誣名夏等死罪，當反坐，煊遂見法。

translations.literal: Tan Tai shielded Mingxia; when the verdict was submitted the order had not yet been issued; Tan Tai advanced and memorialized that Xuan's charges were all false and that the matters cited had all occurred before the amnesty—Xuan, transferred outside, bore a grudge and had falsely charged Mingxia and others with capital crimes and should suffer the penalty in reverse; Xuan was then executed.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai protected Mingxia; before the sentence was issued he argued that Zhang's charges were false and predated the amnesty—that Zhang, posted elsewhere, bore a grudge and had framed Mingxia for death, and should suffer the penalty himself; Zhang was executed.

sentences.zh: 譚泰愈縱恣，岳爾多其妻弟也，襲一等精奇尼哈番，為奪其族人法喀應襲一等阿思哈尼哈番合併為三等侯；

translations.literal: Tan Tai grew still more arrogant; Yuerduo was his wife's younger brother and had inherited a first-class jingqi nihaan; Tan Tai seized from his clansman Faka the first-class ashan nihaan that Faka should have inherited and merged the two into a third-class marquis;
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai grew bolder still; his brother-in-law Yuerduo held a first-class jingqi nihaan—Tan Tai seized from his kinsman Faka a first-class ashan nihaan due him and merged both into a third-class marquis;

sentences.zh: 佟圖賴其女弟之夫也，時金礪駐防杭州，妄稱員缺，以佟圖賴擬補。

translations.literal: Tongtu was his younger sister's husband; at the time Jin Li was garrisoning Hangzhou and falsely declared a vacancy, nominating Tongtu to fill it.
translations.idiomatic: Tongtu was his sister's husband; Jin Li, then at Hangzhou, invented a vacancy and proposed Tongtu to fill it.

sentences.zh: 上自譚泰袒陳名夏構張煊，心厭惡之。

translations.literal: From the time Tan Tai shielded Chen Mingxia and framed Zhang Xuan, the sovereign's heart turned against him in disgust.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tan Tai had shielded Chen Mingxia and destroyed Zhang Xuan, the emperor had come to loathe him.

sentences.zh: 是歲八月，下詔責其專橫，命執付獄，集廷臣議罪。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year an edict reproached his tyranny, ordered him seized and imprisoned, and convened the court ministers to deliberate his crime.
translations.idiomatic: That August an edict condemned his arrogance, had him arrested, and called the court to judge him.

sentences.zh: 鰲拜复訐譚泰阿附睿親王及營私擅政諸狀，讞皆實。

translations.literal: Oboi again denounced Tan Tai for clinging to Prince Rui and for private dealings and arbitrary government; the findings were all true.
translations.idiomatic: Oboi further charged Tan Tai with siding with Prince Rui and ruling for private gain; every count was sustained.

sentences.zh: 王大臣議誅譚泰及其子孫，上命誅譚泰，籍其家，子孫貸連坐。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers proposed executing Tan Tai and his descendants; the sovereign ordered Tan Tai executed, his household confiscated, and his descendants spared collective punishment.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and ministers voted death for Tan Tai and his line; the emperor executed Tan Tai, confiscated his estate, and spared his descendants collective punishment.

sentences.zh: 何洛會，失其氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: He Luohui's clan is lost; he was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He Luohui, whose clan name is unknown, belonged to the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 父阿吉賴，事太祖，從征戰，官牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His father Ajilai served the Taizu, followed campaigns, and held the office of niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ajilai served Taizu in the wars as a company commander.

sentences.zh: 卒，何洛會嗣，兼巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: When he died, He Luohui succeeded him and also held the post of bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: On his death He Luohui succeeded him and also served as a bayara jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，從伐明，略錦州。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiancong he followed in attacking Ming and raided Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he joined the campaign against Ming and raided Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔免諸功臣徭役，何洛會與焉。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an edict exempted all meritorious ministers from corvée labor; He Luohui was among them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year meritorious ministers were exempted from corvée; He Luohui was included.

sentences.zh: 崇德五年，授正黃旗蒙古固山額真。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongde he was appointed Mongol gusa ejen of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 5 he became Mongol banner commander of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 從睿親王多爾袞伐明，圍錦州。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Rui Dorgon in attacking Ming and besieged Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Rui Dorgon against Ming in the siege of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 調滿洲固山額真。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Manchu gusa ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Manchu banner commander.

sentences.zh: 七年，錦州既下，追論圍錦州時何洛會匿鄂羅塞臣破陣功，當奪官，上宥之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, after Jinzhou fell, it was reviewed that during the siege He Luohui had concealed Orosenchen's merit in breaking the enemy line; he should have been stripped of office, but the sovereign pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, after Jinzhou fell, he was charged with concealing Orosenchen's breakthrough at the siege; though liable to dismissal, the emperor pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 何洛會隸肅親王豪格，頗見任使。

translations.literal: He Luohui was attached to Prince Su Hooge and was much employed and trusted.
translations.idiomatic: He Luohui served under Prince Su Hooge and was much trusted.

sentences.zh: 世祖即位，睿親王攝政，與肅親王有隙。

translations.literal: When the Shizu ascended the throne, Prince Rui acted as regent and was at odds with Prince Su.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shizu came to the throne, Prince Rui was regent and at odds with Prince Su.

sentences.zh: 何洛會訐肅親王與兩黃旗大臣揚善、俄莫克圖、伊成格、羅碩將謀亂，肅親王坐削爵，揚善等皆棄市。

translations.literal: He Luohui denounced Prince Su and the two Yellow Banner ministers Yangshan, Emoketu, Yichengge, and Luoshuo as plotting rebellion; Prince Su was stripped of his rank, and Yangshan and the others were all executed in the market.
translations.idiomatic: He Luohui accused Prince Su and the Plain and Bordered Yellow Banner ministers Yangshan, Emoketu, Yichengge, and Luoshuo of plotting revolt; Prince Su lost his title and they were executed.

sentences.zh: 賞何洛會告姦，籍俄莫克圖、伊成格家畀之，授世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: He Luohui was rewarded for exposing treachery; the households of Emoketu and Yichengge were confiscated and given to him, and he was granted a hereditary office as second-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He Luohui was rewarded for the denunciation; Emoketu and Yichengge's estates were given him, and he received a hereditary second-rank jalan colonelcy.

sentences.zh: 尋從睿親王入關，擊李自成，逐至慶都。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Prince Rui in entering the Pass, attacked Li Zicheng, and pursued him to Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Prince Rui into China, fought Li Zicheng, and pursued him to Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 還，睿親王令奉表迎世祖，擢內大臣，留守盛京。

translations.literal: On returning, Prince Rui ordered him to present a memorial welcoming the Shizu; he was promoted to inner minister and left to guard Mukden.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march Prince Rui sent him to welcome the Shizu; he was made an inner minister and left to hold Mukden.

sentences.zh: 阿哈尼堪將左翼，碩詹將右翼，並於熊耀城、錦州、寧遠、鳳凰城、興京、義州、新城、牛莊、岫岩城各置城守官，皆統於何洛會。

translations.literal: Ahanikan commanded the left wing and Shuozhan the right; garrison commanders were placed at Xiongyao, Jinzhou, Ningyuan, Fenghuangcheng, Xingjing, Yizhou, Xincheng, Niuzhuang, and Xiuyancheng—all under He Luohui's overall command.
translations.idiomatic: Ahanikan led the left wing and Shuozhan the right; garrisons were posted at Xiongyao, Jinzhou, Ningyuan, Fenghuang, Xingjing, Yizhou, Xincheng, Niuzhuang, and Xiuyan—all under He Luohui.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，敘功，進世職一等。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi his merit was reviewed and his hereditary office advanced to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 2 his service was recognized and his hereditary rank raised to first class.

sentences.zh: 旋命率師駐防西安，道河南，討定西平土寇劉洪起等。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered to lead troops to garrison Xi'an; passing through Henan he suppressed the bandits of Xiping such as Liu Hongqi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon told to garrison Xi'an; marching through Henan he put down the Xiping bandits, including Liu Hongqi.

sentences.zh: 是歲十二月，授定西大將軍，命自陝西徇四川。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year he was appointed Grand General for Pacifying the West and ordered to advance into Sichuan from Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That December he was made grand general for the west and ordered into Sichuan from Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 時自成將劉體純等犯商州，叛將賀珍與其黨孫守法、胡向宸等分據漢中、興安。

translations.literal: At the time Li Zicheng's generals Liu Tichun and others raided Shangzhou; the rebel general He Zhen and his partisans Sun Shoufa, Hu Xiangchen, and others held Hanzhong and Xing'an separately.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng's generals Liu Tichun and others were raiding Shangzhou; the rebel He Zhen and his allies Sun Shoufa and Hu Xiangchen held Hanzhong and Xing'an.

sentences.zh: 三年，珍以七萬人犯西安，何洛會督兵迎戰，珍敗走，复逐破之，並破體純商州。

translations.literal: In the third year Zhen attacked Xi'an with seventy thousand men; He Luohui directed the army to meet him; Zhen was defeated and fled; pursuing, he broke him again and also defeated Tichun at Shangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year He Zhen struck Xi'an with seventy thousand men; He Luohui met him, drove him off, pursued and broke him again, and cleared Liu Tichun from Shangzhou.

sentences.zh: 肅親王從入關，破李自成，复爵。

translations.literal: Prince Su had followed in entering the Pass and defeated Li Zicheng; his title was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Su had entered China and defeated Li Zicheng; his title was restored.

sentences.zh: 至是，上命為靖遠大將軍，下四川，召何洛會還京師。

translations.literal: At this point the sovereign appointed him Grand General for Pacifying the Distant Regions to descend into Sichuan and recalled He Luohui to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The throne then made Prince Su grand general for the distant regions and sent him into Sichuan, recalling He Luohui to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 四年，命率師駐防宣府，仍授正黃旗滿洲固山額真。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was ordered to lead troops to garrison Xuanfu and was again appointed Manchu gusa ejen of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he garrisoned Xuanfu and was again made Manchu banner commander of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 五年，調鑲白旗。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was transferred to the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 命佐譚泰定江西，擊破金聲桓、王得仁、李成棟，事具譚泰傳。

translations.literal: He was ordered to assist Tan Tai in pacifying Jiangxi, defeating Jin Shenghuan, Wang Deren, and Li Chengdong—the details are in Tan Tai's biography.
translations.idiomatic: He was ordered to aid Tan Tai in pacifying Jiangxi, defeating Jin Shenghuan, Wang Deren, and Li Chengdong—as recounted in Tan Tai's biography.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜所獲金銀珠玉，進世職三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted the gold, silver, and jewels taken; his hereditary office was advanced to third-rank jingqi nihaan.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he received a share of the gold, silver, and jewels taken and was raised to third-class jingqi nihaan.

sentences.zh: 肅親王師還，貝子屯齊等訐王諸悖妄狀，何洛會復從而證之，遂坐奪爵，以幽系終。

translations.literal: When Prince Su's army returned, Beile Tunqi and others denounced the prince's many rebellious acts; He Luohui again bore witness, and the prince was stripped of his rank and ended his life in close confinement.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Su returned, Beizi Tunqi and others impeached him; He Luohui testified again, and the prince lost his title and died under house arrest.

sentences.zh: 睿親王取肅親王福金，召肅親王諸子入府校射，何洛會詈之曰：「見此鬼魅，不覺心悸！」

translations.literal: Prince Rui took Prince Su's consort Fujin and summoned Prince Su's sons into the mansion for archery practice; He Luohui cursed them, saying: "At the sight of these demons my heart cannot but tremble!"
translations.idiomatic: Prince Rui took Prince Su's consort Fujin and summoned Su's sons to shoot in his mansion; He Luohui swore at them: "These specters make my heart quail!"

sentences.zh: 尚書譚泰聞其語。

translations.literal: Minister Tan Tai heard his words.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Tan Tai heard what he said.

sentences.zh: 及睿親王薨，世祖親政，何洛會語貝子錫翰曰：「兩黃旗大臣與我相惡，我嘗訐告肅親王，今豈肯容我？」

translations.literal: When Prince Rui died and the Shizu assumed personal rule, He Luohui said to Beile Xi Han: "The two Yellow Banner ministers bear me ill will; I once denounced Prince Su—will they now tolerate me?"
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Rui's death, when the Shizu took power, He Luohui told Beizi Xi Han: "The Yellow Banner ministers hate me; I denounced Prince Su—will they spare me now?"

sentences.zh: 八年二月，蘇克薩哈等訐睿親王將率兩白旗移駐永平，且私具上服禦，及薨用斂，何洛會、羅什、博爾惠等皆知狀。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighth year Sukesaha and others denounced Prince Rui for intending to move the two White Banners to garrison at Yongping, for privately preparing imperial robes, and for using them at his burial when he died—He Luohui, Roshi, Boerhui, and others all knew the circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year Sukesaha charged that Prince Rui had planned to move the White Banners to Yongping, had secretly made imperial robes, and had been buried in them—He Luohui, Roshi, Boerhui, and others knew it all.

sentences.zh: 時羅什、博爾惠已先誅，執何洛會，下王大臣會鞫。

translations.literal: Roshi and Boerhui had already been executed; He Luohui was seized and the case sent to the princes and ministers for joint trial.
translations.idiomatic: Roshi and Boerhui were already dead; He Luohui was arrested and tried by the princes and ministers.

sentences.zh: 譚泰、錫翰各以何洛會語告，又追論誣告肅親王罪，與其兄胡錫並磔死，籍其家。

translations.literal: Tan Tai and Xi Han each reported He Luohui's words; his crime of falsely denouncing Prince Su was also reviewed; he and his elder brother Husu were dismembered and executed together, and their households were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Tan Tai and Xi Han repeated his words; his false charge against Prince Su was reviewed as well; he and his brother Husu were executed by dismemberment and their estates seized.

sentences.zh: 錫圖庫，烏扎拉氏，滿洲正白旗人，世居烏拉。

translations.literal: Xitu Ku, of the Ujala clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner, long settled at Wula.
translations.idiomatic: Xitu Ku, of the Ujala clan, belonged to the Plain White Banner and was a native of Wula.

sentences.zh: 兄福蘭，當太祖時來歸，授世職備禦。

translations.literal: His elder brother Fulan came over in the Taizu's time and was granted a hereditary office as defender.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Fulan submitted in Taizu's day and received a hereditary defender's rank.

sentences.zh: 卒，錫圖庫嗣，授牛錄額真，兼巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: When he died, Xitu Ku succeeded him and was appointed niru ejen, also holding the post of bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: On his death Xitu Ku succeeded him as company commander and bayara jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 天聰四年，師克永平，錫圖庫與甲喇額真圖魯什等率兵循徼，得邏卒二、馬十七。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tiancong the army took Yongping; Xitu Ku with jalan ejen Turusi and others led troops on patrol and captured two Ming scouts and seventeen horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 4, after Yongping fell, he patrolled with Jalan Commander Turusi and took two Ming scouts and seventeen horses.

sentences.zh: 五年，诇敵大凌河，得二人以還。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he reconnoitered the enemy at Dalinghe and brought back two prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he scouted Dalinghe and returned with two captives.

sentences.zh: 上伐明，圍大凌河城，敗錦州援兵，錫圖庫皆有功。

translations.literal: When the sovereign attacked Ming, besieged Dalinghe city, and defeated Jinzhou relief troops, Xitu Ku distinguished himself in all these.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ming campaign, the siege of Dalinghe, and the defeat of Jinzhou's relief force, he won merit throughout.

sentences.zh: 六年，復從伐明，略宣府、大同邊外，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he again followed in attacking Ming, raiding beyond the borders of Xuanfu and Datong, and took many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he raided again beyond Xuanfu and Datong and took many heads and prisoners.

sentences.zh: 八年，复略蒙古錫爾哈、錫伯圖諸地，斬七十餘級、俘百餘戶及馬駝，賚以所獲，進世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again raided the Mongol lands of Xierha, Xibetu, and others, taking more than seventy heads and over a hundred households plus horses and camels; he was rewarded with the spoils and advanced to hereditary first-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he raided Xierha and Xibetu, took seventy-odd heads and a hundred households with horses and camels, received a share of the booty, and was raised to first-class hereditary jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 九年，偕噶布什賢噶喇依昂邦勞薩等略明邊，入長城，攻代、朔諸州，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, together with Gūšibuxian galai angbang Laosa and others, he raided the Ming frontier, entered the Great Wall, attacked Dai, Shuo, and other prefectures, and took many heads and captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined Laosa and others in a frontier raid, crossed the Great Wall, struck Dai and Shuo, and took many heads and prisoners.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，睿親王多爾袞率師伐明，攻寧遠，錫圖庫以二十人前驅，至中後所及山海關外诇敵，屢得邏卒，並獲其馬，又於前屯衛設伏敗敵。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde Prince Rui Dorgon led an army against Ming and attacked Ningyuan; Xitu Ku went ahead with twenty men, reconnoitered the enemy as far as Zhonghousuo and beyond Shanhaiguan, repeatedly captured Ming scouts and seized their horses, and also set an ambush at Qiantunwei and defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1, as Prince Rui Dorgon besieged Ningyuan, he led twenty men ahead to scout as far as Zhonghousuo and beyond Shanhaiguan, repeatedly took Ming scouts and their horses, and ambushed the enemy at Qiantunwei.

sentences.zh: 喀木尼堪部葉類等盜科爾沁諸部馬叛走，錫圖庫率巴牙喇壯達八人詣寧古塔，與梅勒額真吳巴海督兵追之。

translations.literal: Yelei and others of the Kamniikan tribe stole horses from the Khorchin tribes and fled in rebellion; Xitu Ku led eight bayara dartans to Ningguta and, with meiren ejen Wubahai, directed troops in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: When Yelei of the Kamniikan band stole Khorchin horses and fled, Xitu Ku took eight bayara officers to Ningguta and pursued with Commander Wubahai.

sentences.zh: 行數十日，及於溫鐸，招降不從，葉類潛遁，盡殲其黨九十四人，俘婦女八十餘，得馬五十六；

translations.literal: After marching several tens of days they overtook them at Wenduo; surrender was offered but refused; Yelei slipped away in secret; his entire band of ninety-four was annihilated; over eighty women were captured and fifty-six horses taken;
translations.idiomatic: After many days they caught them at Wenduo; when surrender was refused Yelei slipped away, but ninety-four of his followers were killed, eighty-odd women taken, and fifty-six horses seized;

sentences.zh: 复逐捕葉類，入山，射之殪。

translations.literal: pursuing again they captured Yelei in the mountains and shot him dead.
translations.idiomatic: pursuing into the hills they shot Yelei dead.

sentences.zh: 師還，上遣大臣出迎五里，宴勞，進世職一等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: When the army returned the sovereign sent a minister to welcome them five li out, held a feast in their honor, and advanced his hereditary office to first-rank meiren janggin.
translations.idiomatic: On their return a minister met them five li out, they were feasted, and he was raised to first-class hereditary meiren colonel.

sentences.zh: 五年，命偕巴牙喇纛章京濟什哈率師並徵蒙古敖漢、柰曼、烏喇特諸部兵伐索倫部，敗敵於甘河，擒部長博木博郭爾，籍千餘戶，得馬數百。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was ordered, together with bayara standard-bearer Jisheha, to lead an army and also levy troops from the Mongol Aohan, Naiman, and Urad tribes to attack the Solon; the enemy was defeated on the Gan River; the chieftain Bombogor was captured; over a thousand households were registered; and several hundred horses were taken.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he and Jisheha led a combined force with Aohan, Naiman, and Urad auxiliaries against the Solon, routed them on the Gan, captured chieftain Bombogor, registered a thousand households, and took hundreds of horses.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜宴北驛館，進世職三等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was feasted at the North Post Station and advanced to hereditary third-rank angbang janggin.
translations.idiomatic: On return he was feasted at the North Post Station and raised to third-class hereditary angbang colonel.

sentences.zh: 旋授本旗梅勒額真。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed meiren ejen of his own banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made meiren commander of his banner.

sentences.zh: 七年，從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，自薊州越明都，下山東。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Beile Abatai in attacking Ming, passing from Jizhou beyond the Ming capital down into Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Beile Abatai against Ming, marching from Jizhou past the capital into Shandong.

sentences.zh: 師還，以先出邊，部議當奪官，命寬之，白金百。

translations.literal: When the army returned, because he had left the frontier early the ministry proposed stripping him of office; he was ordered pardoned and given a hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On return he was liable to dismissal for leaving the frontier early but was pardoned and given a hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 八年，擢巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to bayara banner standard-bearer.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he became chief of the bayara guard.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從睿親王多爾袞伐明，敗李自成將唐通於一片石，遂入山海關，屢戰皆勝；

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed Prince Rui Dorgon against Ming, defeated Li Zicheng's general Tang Tong at Yipianshi, then entered Shanhaiguan and won repeated victories;
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he followed Prince Rui Dorgon, routed Li Zicheng's general Tang Tong at Yipianshi, entered Shanhaiguan, and won battle after battle;

sentences.zh: 敗自成遊騎於三河，追擊至安肅。

translations.literal: he defeated Zicheng's roaming cavalry at Sanhe and pursued to Ansu.
translations.idiomatic: he broke Zicheng's scouts at Sanhe and pursued to Ansu.

sentences.zh: 旋從固山額真葉臣等取太原，戰於汾州、於絳州，屢破敵。

translations.literal: Soon he followed gusa ejen Yechen and others in taking Taiyuan, fought at Fenzhou and Jiangzhou, and repeatedly broke the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Yechen in taking Taiyuan and repeatedly defeated the enemy at Fenzhou and Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二年，進二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the second year he was advanced to second-rank jingqi nihaan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was raised to second-class jingqi nihaan.

sentences.zh: 時自成猶據陝西，師自潼關、綏德南北兩路入，錫圖庫率師與北路軍會，敗賊延安。

translations.literal: At the time Zicheng still held Shaanxi; the army entered by northern and southern routes from Tongguan and Suide; Xitu Ku led his force to join the northern route army and defeated the bandits at Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: While Zicheng still held Shaanxi, the army entered by Tongguan and Suide; Xitu Ku joined the northern column and defeated the rebels at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 自成走入湖廣，鍚圖庫移兵從之，自安陸至於荊門，屢擊敗自成兵。

translations.literal: Zicheng fled into Huguang; Xitu Ku shifted his army in pursuit from Anlu to Jingmen and repeatedly defeated Zicheng's troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Zicheng fled into Huguang, Xitu Ku followed from Anlu to Jingmen and repeatedly defeated his forces.

sentences.zh: 三年，復從肅親王豪格下四川，討張獻忠。

translations.literal: In the third year he again followed Prince Su Hooge into Sichuan to suppress Zhang Xianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Hooge into Sichuan against Zhang Xianzhong.

sentences.zh: 五年，進世職一等。

translations.literal: In the fifth year his hereditary office was advanced to first rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year his hereditary rank rose to first class.

sentences.zh: 復從鄭親王濟爾哈朗下湖南。

translations.literal: Again he followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang into Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang into Hunan.

sentences.zh: 六年，師次長沙，錫圖庫從左翼巴牙喇纛章京努三率兵前驅，攻湘潭。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the army halted at Changsha; Xitu Ku followed the left-wing bayara standard-bearer Nusan leading troops as vanguard to attack Xiangtan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, as the army halted at Changsha, he advanced with Nusan of the left wing against Xiangtan.

sentences.zh: 努三軍北門，錫圖庫軍西門，遂克之。

translations.literal: Nusan's force attacked the north gate and Xitu Ku's the west gate, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: Nusan struck the north gate and Xitu Ku the west, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 進徇永興，斬明將尹舉智、杜貞明等。

translations.literal: Advancing to overrun Yongxing, he beheaded the Ming generals Yin Juzhi, Du Zhenming, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on to Yongxing, he killed Ming generals Yin Juzhi and Du Zhenming.

sentences.zh: 再進定寶慶，取全州，破明將焦璉。

translations.literal: Advancing again he pacified Baoqing, took Quanzhou, and defeated the Ming general Jiao Lian.
translations.idiomatic: He then pacified Baoqing, took Quanzhou, and broke the Ming general Jiao Lian.

sentences.zh: 又移兵克永安關，取道州。

translations.literal: Shifting his army again he took Yong'anguan and captured Daozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then took Yong'anguan and Daozhou.

sentences.zh: 師還，賜白金三百。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was granted three hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On return he received three hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 七年，睿親王多爾袞薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Prince Rui Dorgon died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Prince Rui Dorgon died.

sentences.zh: 八年春，吳拜、羅什、博爾輝等訐英親王阿濟格將謀亂，鞫實，錫圖庫坐與謀，誅死，籍其家。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year Wubai, Roshi, Boerhui, and others denounced Prince Ying Ajige for plotting rebellion; the case was proved; Xitu Ku was implicated in the plot, executed, and his household confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year Wubai, Roshi, and Boerhui exposed Prince Ying Ajige's plot; Xitu Ku was found complicit, executed, and his estate seized.

sentences.zh: 博爾輝，他塔喇氏，滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Boerhui, of the Tatara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Boerhui, of the Tatara clan, belonged to the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 初以巴牙喇壯達從征棟奎部，有俘馘。

translations.literal: At first, as a bayara dartan, he followed campaigns against the Dongkui tribe and took captives and heads.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as a bayara officer against the Dongkui and took prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 天聰三年，從太宗伐明，自龍井關入攻遵化。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong he followed the Taizong in attacking Ming, entering through Longjing Pass to assault Zunhua.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 3 he followed Taizong against Ming, entering by Longjing Pass to attack Zunhua.

sentences.zh: 明總兵趙率教自山海關赴援，與戰，博爾輝斬其副將，明兵驚潰。

translations.literal: Ming regional commander Zhao Shuaijiao came from Shanhaiguan to relieve the city; in the engagement Boerhui killed his deputy commander and the Ming troops fled in panic.
translations.idiomatic: Ming commander Zhao Shuaijiao marched from Shanhaiguan to relieve the city; Boerhui killed his deputy and the Ming force broke in panic.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢巴牙喇甲喇章京，兼戶部參政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to bayara jalan janggin and also made a participating secretary of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he became bayara jalan colonel and a participating secretary of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 復從伐明，與明兵遇寧遠，擊殺前隊七人。

translations.literal: Again following in attacking Ming, he met Ming troops at Ningyuan and killed seven men of their vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On another Ming campaign he met the enemy at Ningyuan and killed seven of their vanguard.

sentences.zh: 八年，復從伐明，攻大同，明兵三千自龍門迎戰，博爾輝與噶布什賢章京錫特庫、牛錄額真星訥等奮擊破之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he again followed in attacking Ming and assaulted Datong; three thousand Ming troops came from Longmen to give battle; Boerhui with Gūšibuxian janggin Xiteku, niru ejen Xingne, and others charged fiercely and routed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, at Datong, three thousand Ming troops met them at Longmen; Boerhui, Xiteku, Xingne, and others charged and broke them.

sentences.zh: 九年，命偕承政馬福塔齎敕諭朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was ordered, together with chief administrator Ma Futa, to carry an imperial edict to the king of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he and Chief Administrator Ma Futa bore an edict to the king of Korea.

sentences.zh: 師出邊招察哈爾部眾，自歸化經明邊東還，博爾輝殿。

translations.literal: When the army went beyond the frontier to summon the Chahar tribes, returning east along the Ming border from Guihua, Boerhui commanded the rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: When the army went out to summon the Chahar and returned east from Guihua along the Ming border, Boerhui commanded the rear.

sentences.zh: 明兵二百三十追擊我師，博爾輝以二十人擊卻之，斬十人，俘一人，得馬三。

translations.literal: Two hundred thirty Ming troops pursued our army; Boerhui with twenty men drove them back, beheaded ten, captured one, and took three horses.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred thirty Ming troops pursued them; with twenty men Boerhui drove them off, killed ten, took one prisoner and three horses.

sentences.zh: 明兵從我師，有垂為所獲者，博爾輝救之得脫。

translations.literal: Ming troops followed our army; when some were on the verge of capture, Boerhui rescued them and they escaped.
translations.idiomatic: As Ming troops pressed the rear, he rescued men about to be taken.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，敘功，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde his merit was reviewed and he was granted a hereditary office as niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 his service was recognized and he received a hereditary company commander's rank.

sentences.zh: 三年，裁參政，專任巴牙喇甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the third year the participating secretary post was abolished and he served solely as bayara jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the revenue post was dropped and he served only as bayara jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，兼任刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi he concurrently served as an administrative officer of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he also served on the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 從入關，擊李自成，敘功，進世職二等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: Following in entering the Pass he attacked Li Zicheng; his merit was reviewed and his hereditary office advanced to second-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: He crossed into China and fought Li Zicheng; for his service he was raised to second-class hereditary jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 旋署巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: He was soon made acting bayara banner standard-bearer.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became acting chief of the bayara guard.

sentences.zh: 從順承郡王勒克德渾下湖廣，師至武昌。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Shuncheng Lekedehun into Huguang; the army reached Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Shuncheng Lekedehun into Huguang as far as Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 時自成將馬進忠、王進才既降复叛，據岳州，​​令博爾輝率師討之，次臨湘，擊敗其兵。

translations.literal: At the time Zicheng's generals Ma Jinzhong and Wang Jincai had surrendered and rebelled again, holding Yuezhou; Boerhui was ordered to lead troops against them; halting at Linxiang he defeated their army.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng's generals Ma Jinzhong and Wang Jincai had rebelled again at Yuezhou; Boerhui was sent against them and defeated them at Linxiang.

sentences.zh: 進攻岳州，進忠、進才走長沙，逐擊敗之，其將黑運昌以舟師降。

translations.literal: Advancing to attack Yuezhou, Jinzhong and Jincai fled to Changsha; pursuing, he defeated them again, and their general Hei Yunchang surrendered with his fleet.
translations.idiomatic: At Yuezhou the rebels fled to Changsha; he pursued and broke them again, and their admiral Hei Yunchang surrendered his fleet.

sentences.zh: 師還，優賚。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On return he was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 五年，真除巴牙喇纛章京，列議政大臣，進世職二等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was formally appointed bayara banner standard-bearer, ranked among the deliberative ministers, and advanced to hereditary second-rank ashan nihaan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was confirmed as chief of the bayara guard, made a deliberative minister, and raised to second-class ashan nihaan.

sentences.zh: 睿親王攝政，諸王多與忤。

translations.literal: When Prince Rui acted as regent, many princes clashed with him.
translations.idiomatic: Under Prince Rui's regency many princes fell foul of him.

sentences.zh: 鄭親王濟爾哈朗降郡王，旋复爵。

translations.literal: Prince Zheng Jirhalang was reduced to commandery prince, then soon had his rank restored.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zheng Jirhalang was demoted to commandery prince, then restored.

sentences.zh: 初以端重親王博洛、敬謹親王尼堪佐理事，亦以專擅降爵。

translations.literal: At first Princes Duanzhong Boluo and Jingjin Nikan assisted in government and were also reduced for arbitrary conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Duanzhong Boluo and Jingjin Nikan, who had helped govern, were likewise demoted for overreaching.

sentences.zh: 博爾輝及諸大臣羅什、額克親、吳拜、蘇拜皆謹事睿親王，從王獵喀喇城。

translations.literal: Boerhui and the ministers Roshi, Ekeqin, Wubai, and Subai all dutifully served Prince Rui and accompanied the prince hunting at Kalacheng.
translations.idiomatic: Boerhui and ministers Roshi, Ekeqin, Wubai, and Subai all served Prince Rui faithfully and hunted with him at Kalacheng.

sentences.zh: 王薨，喪還。

translations.literal: When the prince died the funeral procession returned.
translations.idiomatic: When the prince died the funeral cortege returned.

sentences.zh: 英親王阿濟格為睿親王同母兄，欲繼王柄政，博爾輝等與阿爾津共發其罪，英親王奪爵幽禁，賞諸告者，博爾輝進世職二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Prince Ying Ajige, Prince Rui's elder brother by the same mother, wished to succeed to the prince's power; Boerhui and others, together with A'erjin, exposed his crimes; Prince Ying was stripped of rank and confined; the informers were rewarded; Boerhui was advanced to hereditary second-rank jingqi nihaan.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Ying Ajige, Dorgon's elder brother, sought his power; Boerhui and A'erjin exposed him; Prince Ying was disgraced and confined; the informers were rewarded and Boerhui raised to second-class jingqi nihaan.

sentences.zh: 博爾輝等傳睿親王遺言，复理事二王親王爵，以告兩黃旗大臣。

translations.literal: Boerhui and others transmitted Prince Rui's dying words, restoring the two princes who had assisted in government to princely rank, and reported this to the two Yellow Banner ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Boerhui relayed Prince Rui's last wish to restore Boluo and Nikan to princely rank and told the Yellow Banner ministers.

sentences.zh: 居月餘，命未下，博爾輝有疾，穆爾泰往視之，博爾輝以為言。

translations.literal: After more than a month the order had not been issued; Boerhui fell ill; Murutai visited him, and Boerhui spoke of the matter.
translations.idiomatic: After a month no order came; Boerhui fell ill; Murutai visited him and Boerhui complained of the delay.

sentences.zh: 穆爾泰告額爾德赫，額爾德赫告敬謹郡王尼堪，遂與端重郡王博洛訴於鄭親王。

translations.literal: Murutai told E'erdehe; E'erdehe told Commandery Prince Jingjin Nikan; they then appealed with Commandery Prince Duanzhong Boluo to Prince Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: Murutai told E'erdehe, who told Prince Jingjin Nikan; they and Prince Duanzhong Boluo appealed to Prince Zheng.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，复二王爵。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year the two princes' ranks were restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year the two princes were restored.

sentences.zh: 越八日，執博爾輝等下獄，坐博爾輝、羅什動搖國事，蠱惑人心，論死，籍其家。

translations.literal: Eight days later Boerhui and others were seized and imprisoned; Boerhui and Roshi were charged with shaking state affairs and deluding hearts; death was proposed and their households confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Eight days later Boerhui and Roshi were arrested for subverting the state and misleading the court; death was proposed and their estates seized.

sentences.zh: 額克親削宗室籍，及吳拜、蘇拜皆奪官為民。

translations.literal: Ekeqin was struck from the imperial clan register; Wubai and Subai were all stripped of office and made commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Ekeqin was struck from the clan rolls; Wubai and Subai were reduced to commoners.

sentences.zh: 議上，得旨：「朕每聞刑人，殊不忍。

translations.literal: When the deliberation was submitted, an edict came: "Whenever I hear of punishing people, I am deeply unwilling.
translations.idiomatic: When the verdict went up, the emperor replied: "I shrink from every execution.

sentences.zh: 二人罪當誅，姑宥死何如？」

translations.literal: These two men's crimes merit death—might we for now spare their lives?"
translations.idiomatic: These two deserve death—might we spare them for now?"

sentences.zh: 王大臣復以初議上，乃誅死。

translations.literal: The princes and ministers resubmitted the original proposal, and they were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The princes and ministers resubmitted the original sentence, and both were executed.

sentences.zh: 冷僧機，納喇氏，滿洲正黃旗人，葉赫部長金台石之族也。

translations.literal: Leng Sengji, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner and a kinsman of Yehe chieftain Gintaisi.
translations.idiomatic: Leng Sengji, of the Nara clan, belonged to the Plain Yellow Banner and was kin to the Yehe chieftain Gintaisi.

sentences.zh: 葉赫亡，來歸，隸正藍旗，屬貝勒莽古爾泰。

translations.literal: When Yehe perished he came over and was attached to the Plain Blue Banner under Beile Manggu'ertai.
translations.idiomatic: When Yehe fell he submitted, joined the Plain Blue Banner, and served under Beile Manggu'ertai.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，敖漢部長索諾木來歸，尚公主為額駙，以冷僧機隸焉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong the Aohan chieftain Sonomu came over, married an imperial princess as consort, and Leng Sengji was placed under him.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 the Aohan chieftain Sonomu submitted, married a princess, and Leng Sengji was assigned to him.

sentences.zh: 莽古爾泰既卒，九年，冷僧機詣法司言莽古爾泰及貝勒德格類與公主及索諾木結黨，設誓謀不軌。

translations.literal: After Manggu'ertai died, in the ninth year Leng Sengji went to the judicial offices and reported that Manggu'ertai and Beile Degesi, together with the princess and Sonomu, had formed a faction, sworn oaths, and plotted treason.
translations.idiomatic: After Manggu'ertai's death, in the ninth year Leng Sengji reported to the courts that Manggu'ertai and Beile Degesi, with the princess and Sonomu, had sworn a treasonous pact.

sentences.zh: 冷僧機與甲喇額真屯布祿、巴克什愛巴禮並下法司，鞫實，冷僧機以自首免罪，屯布祿、​​愛巴禮皆坐誅，籍其家以★K2冷僧機，改隸正黃旗，授世職三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: Leng Sengji, together with jalan ejen Tunbulu and secretary Aibali, were all sent to the judicial offices; the case was proved; Leng Sengji was spared punishment for having confessed; Tunbulu and Aibali were both executed; their households were confiscated and given to Leng Sengji; he was transferred to the Plain Yellow Banner and granted a hereditary office as third-rank meiren janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Leng Sengji, Jalan Commander Tunbulu, and Secretary Aibali were tried; the plot was proved; Leng Sengji was spared for confessing; Tunbulu and Aibali were executed and their estates given to him; he was moved to the Plain Yellow Banner as third-class hereditary meiren colonel.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，固山額真都類坐事下兵部待鞫，兵部參政穆爾泰令諸在系者避都類。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde gusa ejen Dulei was implicated in a case and held at the Board of War awaiting trial; participating secretary Murutai of the Board ordered all detainees to avoid Dulei.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 banner commander Dulei was held at the Board of War; Murutai ordered other prisoners to avoid him.

sentences.zh: 或以告冷僧機，聞於上，穆爾泰及同官皆坐降罰，授冷僧機一等侍衛。

translations.literal: Someone reported this to Leng Sengji; it reached the sovereign; Murutai and his colleagues were all punished with demotion; Leng Sengji was appointed first-rank guardsman.
translations.idiomatic: Someone told Leng Sengji; the emperor heard; Murutai and his colleagues were demoted; Leng Sengji was made a first-rank guardsman.

sentences.zh: 七年，祖大壽來歸，上幸牧馬所，命內大臣侍衛與大壽等校射，中的者有所賜，冷僧機得駝一。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Zu Dashou came over; the sovereign visited the horse pastures and ordered inner ministers and guardsmen to compete in archery with Dashou and others; those who hit the target received gifts; Leng Sengji won a camel.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Zu Dashou submitted; at an archery contest with him Leng Sengji hit the mark and won a camel.

sentences.zh: 世祖即位，授內大臣。

translations.literal: When the Shizu ascended the throne he was appointed inner minister.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shizu came to the throne he was made an inner minister.

sentences.zh: 順治二年，進二等阿思哈尼哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shunzhi he was advanced to second-rank ashan nihaan with an additional tosara haan.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 2 he was raised to second-class ashan nihaan with an added tosara haan.

sentences.zh: 譚泰訐索尼，引冷僧機為證，謝未聞，坐徇庇，當削世職籍沒，上貰之。

translations.literal: Tan Tai denounced Sonin and cited Leng Sengji as witness; Leng Sengji declined, saying he had not heard; he was charged with favoritism and should have been stripped of hereditary rank and had his household confiscated; the sovereign pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: When Tan Tai denounced Sonin and called Leng Sengji as witness, he pleaded ignorance; though liable to lose rank and estate for favoritism, the emperor spared him.

sentences.zh: 旋進世職三等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Soon his hereditary office was advanced to third-rank jingqi nihaan.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon raised to third-class jingqi nihaan.

sentences.zh: 七年，睿親王有疾，怨上未臨視，冷僧機及貝子錫翰等奏請上臨視，睿親王坐以擅請降世職，恩詔復故，進一等伯。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Prince Rui fell ill and resented that the sovereign had not visited him; Leng Sengji and Beile Xi Han and others memorialized asking the sovereign to visit; Prince Rui was punished for unauthorized solicitation with reduction of hereditary rank; an amnesty edict restored him, and Leng Sengji was advanced to first-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, when Prince Rui fell ill and resented the emperor's absence, Leng Sengji and Beizi Xi Han asked the throne to visit; Leng Sengji was reduced in hereditary rank for the unauthorized request, then an amnesty restored him and advanced him to first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 睿親王薨，以豫親王多鐸子多爾博為後，襲爵。

translations.literal: When Prince Rui died, Prince Yu Dodo's son Duo'erbo was made his heir and inherited the title.
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Rui's death, Dodo's son Duo'erbo succeeded to his title.

sentences.zh: 冷僧機言於上曰：「昔太宗登遐，兩黃旗大臣誓立肅親王。

translations.literal: Leng Sengji said to the sovereign: "In the past, when the Taizong passed away, the two Yellow Banner ministers swore to enthrone Prince Su.
translations.idiomatic: Leng Sengji told the emperor: "When Taizong died, the Yellow Banner ministers swore to make Prince Su emperor.

sentences.zh: 睿親王定策奉上紹統，多爾博宜特見優遇。」

translations.literal: Prince Rui settled the policy and presented Your Majesty to continue the succession; Duo'erbo ought to receive special favor."
translations.idiomatic: Prince Rui set the succession and brought you to the throne; Duo'erbo deserves special favor."

sentences.zh: 又舉侍衛羅什，羅什上為冷僧機乞恩。

translations.literal: He also recommended the guardsman Roshi; Roshi memorialized asking favor for Leng Sengji.
translations.idiomatic: He also named the guardsman Roshi, who memorialized asking favor for him.

sentences.zh: 八年，鄭親王濟爾哈朗等劾羅什蠱惑諸王，坐誅，辭連冷僧機。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Prince Zheng Jirhalang and others impeached Roshi for deluding the princes; he was executed, and his testimony implicated Leng Sengji.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Prince Zheng Jirhalang impeached Roshi for misleading the princes; Roshi was executed and implicated Leng Sengji.

sentences.zh: 上因命諸大臣詰誓立肅親王事，冷僧機窮，諸大臣兼發阿諛睿親王諸罪，論斬籍沒，命寬之。

translations.literal: The sovereign therefore ordered the ministers to interrogate the matter of the oath to enthrone Prince Su; Leng Sengji was cornered; the ministers also exposed his crimes of flattering Prince Rui; execution and confiscation were proposed; he was ordered pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then had ministers examine the oath to enthrone Prince Su; cornered, Leng Sengji was also charged with flattering Prince Rui; though death and confiscation were proposed, he was spared.

sentences.zh: 九年，追論冷僧機與貝子鞏阿岱、錫翰，內大臣西訥布庫等迎合睿親王，亂國政，下王大臣鞫實，與鞏阿岱、錫翰、西訥布庫等並誅，籍其家。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Leng Sengji was again prosecuted together with Beile Gongadai, Xi Han, inner minister Xinebuku, and others for currying favor with Prince Rui and throwing state affairs into disorder; the case was sent to the princes and ministers; the facts were proved; he was executed together with Gongadai, Xi Han, Xinebuku, and the others, and their households were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was prosecuted again with Gongadai, Xi Han, and Xinebuku for pandering to Prince Rui and corrupting government; tried by the princes and ministers, he was executed with them and their estates seized.

sentences.zh: 論曰：定金聲桓、王得仁之亂，譚泰專將，何洛會為之佐。

translations.literal: Commentary: In pacifying the rebellion of Jin Shenghuan and Wang Deren, Tan Tai was sole commander and He Luohui his assistant.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators say: In putting down Jin Shenghuan and Wang Deren, Tan Tai commanded alone and He Luohui assisted him.

sentences.zh: 錫圖庫、博爾輝亦久從征戰有勞。

translations.literal: Xitu Ku and Boerhui also followed campaigns for many years with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Xitu Ku and Boerhui too had long followed campaigns with merit.

sentences.zh: 睿親王既薨，諸阿附者乃互相傾，何洛會之獄，譚泰證之；

translations.literal: After Prince Rui died, those who had clung to him turned on one another; in He Luohui's case Tan Tai bore witness;
translations.idiomatic: After Prince Rui's death his followers turned on one another; Tan Tai testified in He Luohui's case;

sentences.zh: 錫圖庫之誅，博爾輝等發之：轉相排軋，同就誅夷。

translations.literal: Xitu Ku's execution was exposed by Boerhui and others: each undermining the other, they alike met execution.
translations.idiomatic: Xitu Ku's execution was exposed by Boerhui and others: each denouncing the other, they all went to execution together.

sentences.zh: 若冷僧機者，專事告訐，其及也亦宜矣。

translations.literal: As for one like Leng Sengji, who devoted himself to denunciation, it was fitting that ruin should overtake him.
translations.idiomatic: As for Leng Sengji, who lived by accusation, his fall was only just.
